svg.title: The same pasture seen from the road and from the air
svg.desc: One pasture drawn twice, one panel above the other. In the top panel, only the brush in a wedge near the road is visible and the rest of the pasture is greyed out and labelled as estimated. In the bottom panel, every woody plant is marked individually, filled circles for mesquite and open circles for juniper, showing the brush clumped along the draw and thin on the open flat.
